$description: Kalea brand identity v1 design tokens. Single source of truth for color, type, and radius; apps/web consumes these values. See brand/README.md for usage rules.

ocean.use: Primary brand color: mark buildings, primary actions, links, headings on light backgrounds.

apricot.use: Accent: the street in the mark, highlights, one detail per icon. Never text on white.

violet.use: Support accent for illustrations, charts, and secondary highlights.

lime.use: Support accent for illustrations and charts. Not a success color.

deep.use: Dark covers, hero backgrounds, and dark-mode surfaces.

ink.use: Body text and mono logo on light backgrounds.

muted.use: Secondary text, captions, and the Powered by Kalea footer.

surface.use: Page and card backgrounds behind white panels.

white.use: Primary light background and text on Ocean or Deep.

ocean-100.use: Selected states and soft Ocean backgrounds.

apricot-100.use: Soft highlight backgrounds behind Ink text.

success.use: Completed transactions and positive status. Kept separate from brand Lime.

warning.use: Pending or attention states. Use with an icon; below 4.5:1 on white for small text.

info.use: Neutral informational notices. Kept separate from brand Ocean.

mono.value: "Sometype Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.use: Data, rates, code, IDs, and uppercase eyebrows.
